    // Session UUID logic using sessionStorage
    function storageAvailable(type) {
        try {
            var storage = window[type],
                x = '__storage_test__';
            storage.setItem(x, x);
            storage.removeItem(x);
            return true;
        } catch (e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    window.generateUUIDv4 = function() {
        // RFC4122 version 4 compliant UUID
        return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, function(c) {
            var r = Math.random() * 16 | 0,
                v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3 | 0x8);
            return v.toString(16);
        });
    };

    let sessionUuidKey = 'session_uuid';
    let sessionUuid = null;
    if (storageAvailable('sessionStorage')) {
        sessionUuid = sessionStorage.getItem(sessionUuidKey);
        if (!sessionUuid) {
            sessionUuid = window.generateUUIDv4();
            sessionStorage.setItem(sessionUuidKey, sessionUuid);
        }
    } else {
        // fallback: generate a new UUID for this page load
        sessionUuid = window.generateUUIDv4();
    }
    window.sessionUuid = sessionUuid;

    // Generate view_instance_uuid for every page view
    window.viewInstanceUuid = window.generateUUIDv4();
</script>

    window.zdconsent.run.push(() => {
        const scrollDepths = [10, 25, 50, 75, 90, 100];

        // Insert scroll depth markers into the document
        const insertScrollDepthMarkers = () => {
            const mainElement = document.querySelector('main') || document.querySelector('#main');

            if (!mainElement) {
                console.warn('No main element found for scroll depth tracking');
                return;
            }

            // Ensure main element is positioned for absolute children
            if (getComputedStyle(mainElement).position === 'static') {
                mainElement.style.position = 'relative';
            }

            scrollDepths.forEach(depth => {
                const marker = document.createElement('div');
                marker.setAttribute('data-page-scroll-depth', depth);
                marker.style.cssText = `position: absolute; top: ${depth}%; height: 1px; width: 100%; pointer-events: none;`;
                mainElement.appendChild(marker);
            });
        };

        // Observer to track when scroll depth markers become visible
        const scrollDepthObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    const depth = entry.target.getAttribute('data-page-scroll-depth');
                    gtag('event', 'scroll', {
                        percent_scrolled: parseInt(depth),
                    });
                    entry.target.remove(); // Remove marker after firing
                }
            });
        });

        // Initialize markers and start observing
        const initScrollDepthTracking = () => {
            insertScrollDepthMarkers();
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-page-scroll-depth]').forEach(marker => {
                scrollDepthObserver.observe(marker);
            });
        };

        // Run immediately if page already loaded, otherwise wait for load event
        if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
            initScrollDepthTracking();
        } else {
            window.addEventListener('load', initScrollDepthTracking);
        }
    });
</script>
